name: W. K. DuVal
role: Stockholder in the LeMoyne Cattle Co.
bio: W. K. DuVal of Wheeling, West Virginia, was a stockholder in the LeMoyne Cattle Co. and in September 1885 visited Medora, where it was decided not to move the L C herd that fall. In February 1886 the paper called him a north-of-the-Yellowstone stockman returning from a business trip.

moments.label: Visited as LeMoyne Cattle Co. stockholder

mentions: Messrs. Julius Le Moyne, of Washington, Pa., Joseph U. Rose, Pittsburgh, W. K. Duval, Wheeling, W. V. and Harvey T. Halleck, Washington, Pa., have been in town several days, arranging to put in cattle on Tepee bottom, under the management of D. K. Wade.…

Measers, Small, of Glendive, and DuVal, a stock holder in the LeMoyne cattle Co., were here Monday. It has been decided not to remove the L C herd this fall and on account of the overstocking of the North Yel…
W. K. DuVol, a north-of-the-Yellowstone stockman, was on the west-bound train Monday night. He was returning home from an extended business trip.
